Post 1

📈 New 50-day low set, then a 67.70pt reversal. ASX 200 closed +0.79% at 8,682.10. Tech led the recovery hard. The index is flat on the week — bulls absorbed the dip, but the scoreboard is still square. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔺 IT surged +4.45%, the clear session winner. Energy +1.48%, Materials +1.14%, Financials +1.03% all contributed. On the other side, A-REITs dropped -1.63% and Health Care fell -1.10%. Rate sensitivity bit both sectors. #ASX #ausbiz #property #healthcare

Post 3

MP1 up 10.32% to AUD 22.34. Megaport led a broad tech rally alongside WiseTech +6.67% and Data#3 +7.76%. When three names in the same sector all surge together, that's rotation money moving with conviction, not noise. #ASX #tech #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,072.33/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6944. Silver AUD 88.57/oz. Metals bid firm — a weaker AUD amplifies every commodity move for local producers. Materials sector gained +1.14% on the day. #ASX #gold #metals #ausbiz

Post 5

Index flat over five days despite today's bounce. Watch whether IT holds its +4.45% gain — if MP1 and WTC fade early next week, the recovery story unravels fast. Bulls or bears: does 8,682 hold? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #investing
